preconditions.description: The input integer n must be between 4 and 1000 inclusive.
The input integer n must be a multiple of 4.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= grid[i][j] < n**2 for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: All integers in the grid must be between 0 and n^2 - 1 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))) == n**2
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n^2 - 1 must appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: all(xor_row == xor_col for xor_row in (reduce(xor, row) for row in grid) for xor_col in (reduce(xor, column) for column in zip(*grid)))
postconditions.description: The XOR of all elements in each row and each column must be the same.
